topic: Ground Support Equipment – Classification, Records of Holding, Servicing, Testing and Calibration, and Periodic Maintenance and Servicing
syllabus_extract: Ground Support Equipment – Classification, Records of Holding, Servicing, Testing and Calibration, and Periodic Maintenance and Servicing
specific_objectives: 38.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain principles of Correct Aircraft Maintenance Practices, tools and their usage

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of GSE classification records and periodic maintenance checklists; Safety: Wear PPE, verify equipment isolation; Supervision: Instructor monitors record accuracy and tool handling.
intro_questions: What is the primary definition of Ground Support Equipment?
List three categories of GSE used in aviation maintenance.
Why is the Records of Holding critical for GSE management?

development.content:
GSE Classification Principles
Records of Holding Management
Servicing Procedures Overview

Testing and Calibration Standards
Periodic Maintenance Schedules
Correct Aircraft Maintenance Practices

Tool Usage and Safety Protocols
Documentation of Maintenance Actions
Troubleshooting Common GSE Failures

summary_questions: Explain the difference between servicing and periodic maintenance for GSE.
Describe the steps required to calibrate a GSE unit correctly.
How do Correct Aircraft Maintenance Practices apply to tool usage?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the classification and maintenance requirements of GSE relevant to the next lesson on common hand-held tools (LP 06).
